query:
SELECT family_id AS "family_id!: i64"
               FROM queries
               WHERE outcome IN ('ok', 'no_flights')
               GROUP BY family_id
               HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN outcome = 'no_flights' THEN id END)
                    > COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN outcome = 'ok' THEN id END), 0)
               ORDER BY family_id
